start: Your profile, a mobile number saved

user_sees: Bar 'Number removed' with 'Undo' (spoken 'Undo: Number removed')
must_not: The bar before the remove saved

user_sees: The number back
The bar goes

start: An active workout, one set just deleted

user_sees: A bar naming what was deleted, with 'Undo'
must_not: The set gone with no way back

steps.action: Keep a finger on the bar for 10 seconds, then lift it
user_sees: The bar stays while touched, then runs its time out
must_not: The bar going while the finger is on it

user_sees: The set back in its place

start: A delete just made, its bar showing

user_sees: The bar goes; the delete stays

steps.action: On another delete, tap 'Undo' twice fast
user_sees: The item back once

start: A delete just made, its bar showing

steps.action: Delete a second item while the first bar shows
user_sees: A fresh bar for the second item with a new 6 seconds
must_not: The second bar timing out early on the first one's clock

steps.action: With the phone's 'Remove animations' on, delete again
user_sees: The bar appears and goes without sliding
